description: The end-to-end acceptance project for active learning on 3D point-cloud classification.
initial_message: Can uncertainty-based active learning outperform random sampling for few-shot 3D point-cloud classification at the same labeling budget?

confirmed_facts.research_question: At the same labeling budget, does uncertainty-based active learning improve few-shot 3D point-cloud classification over random sampling?
confirmed_facts.hypotheses: Uncertainty sampling improves mean accuracy over random sampling; calibration reduces acquisition instability
confirmed_facts.expected_contributions: A reproducible label-budget benchmark; an analysis of calibration and seed sensitivity
confirmed_facts.available_data: ModelNet40 public data under its published license, plus a synthetic smoke-test dataset
confirmed_facts.constraints: One 24GB GPU, USD 50, eight weeks, public data
confirmed_facts.success_criteria: At least two percentage points above random sampling across five seeds with confidence intervals
confirmed_facts.ethics_and_compliance: No personal data, human subjects, or restricted data
